name: Prose Surface
summary: Sooner or later you render writing somebody else wrote — from a CMS, an editor, a Markdown file — inside a box of your own, and you cannot add classes to it. The styling has to hang off the elements, and whatever structure did not survive the trip is simply gone: a quote that swallowed its attribution, a list that is paragraphs with a bullet typed in front. A box that scrolls is also a control.
demoNote: Every readout here is written by hand and checked against the real accessibility tree by the spec, so it cannot drift. Example 2 puts one long line of code in a surface three ways; example 3 attributes the same quote three ways; example 4 has a typed-in list beside a real one; example 5 clips a box of text and scrolls the same box.
